description: The plot titled “SST-2, dirty-label, poison_num: 16” illustrates ASR values across a set of trigger-word positions for three methods shown as separate lines. The x-axis is categorical (linear ordering) with labels bb, mb, ct, beautiful, excellent, gorgeous, wonderful, brilliant, stunning, and beautifully, spaced evenly with no units. The y-axis is labeled “ASR” on a linear scale, spanning roughly from 0.0 to 1.0 with regularly spaced tick marks at about 0.2 intervals (0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8). The green line with small circular markers (solid) starts near 0.72 at bb, drops to about 0.16 at mb, rises to ~0.26 at ct, then increases to ~0.80 at beautiful and stays in the ~0.80–0.93 range through the remaining categories, ending around 0.93 at beautifully. The orange line with x-shaped markers (solid) begins near 0.12 at bb, dips to ~0.08 at mb, rises to ~0.21 at ct, jumps to ~0.62 at beautiful, then increases gradually through ~0.60 (excellent), ~0.65 (gorgeous), ~0.73 (wonderful), ~0.78 (brilliant), peaks around ~0.92 at stunning, and ends near ~0.85 at beautifully. The purple line with circular markers (solid) starts around 0.40 at bb, rises slightly to ~0.43 at mb, peaks near ~0.89 at ct, drops to ~0.62 at beautiful, rises to ~0.81 at excellent, dips to ~0.72 at gorgeous, peaks again near ~0.91 at wonderful, drops to ~0.82 at brilliant, rises to ~0.90 at stunning, and ends around ~0.90 at beautifully.
